overall_comment: Predictions are based only on structured conventional MRI metadata without diffusion, perfusion, spectroscopy, susceptibility/calcification assessment, or histomolecular testing. The low necrosis proportion and mild enhancement create some uncertainty, but the older age and enhancing, edematous, deep-infiltrative phenotype support an IDH-wildtype grade 4 integrated call.
